gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Bold and playful lines come from Grandstander, every stroke drawn flat and constant. Noto Sans Adlam answers with curve endings held well apart and tall, full lowercase, which is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-adlam-u: Grandstander draws every letter with one unvarying stroke from start to finish, short ascenders and a tall x-height included. Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined sits beside it, spacious at the curve ends.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-anatoli: Chunky, friendly, a bit cheeky: Grandstander keeps its n arch and stem matched in weight. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs then carries a long page with outward-pointing tips and an x-height nearly touching the capitals.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Round, loud and ruler-straight in its lines, Grandstander leads. Noto Sans Arabic follows with wide openings on small letters and a pronounced x-height, so a long page would feel open and easy going.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-armenia: Grandstander keeps its letterforms free of hairlines and swells, so the heading feels blunt and cheerful. And Noto Sans Armenian, with tall full c, s and z, would carry a long passage with a wide, welcoming look.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Grandstander has no hairlines at all, so its stems all match, bold and a little cartoonish. Noto Sans Avestan joins it with curve tips that never touch and a pronounced x-height, giving the page a tidy lift.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-balines: Punchy and round, with a lowercase a free of thin strokes, Grandstander takes the lead. Noto Sans Balinese brings its strongest quality below: a breathing space inside every curved glyph.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Noto Sans Bamum reads with big open counters in every small letter and curves that stop before turning inward. Bamum does the quiet work, while Grandstander, ruler-drawn and constant in width, handles the loud announcing.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-bassa-v: Bold, expressive and brush-like in its plain fixed-width line, Grandstander makes a lively heading. Noto Sans Bassa Vah then lets its dominant midsection and open-jawed c fill every line.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-batak: Fat, friendly letters with no brush-style swell anywhere: that is Grandstander at work up top. And Noto Sans Batak, with its towering x-height, would look cramped only if the heading shrank too far.
